reference.notes:
I implemented `generateFeatureFile` in `src/index.ts`, and all tests pass: 18/18 public and 40/40 private. I didn't change any test or config file, and none of the tests contradicted the spec.

How it works, in the order the code runs:
- **Key check:** the key must match `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-[0-9]+$`. Otherwise it throws an error that includes the key. The key and title are checked before the criteria, so a bad key or empty title is refused even when there are no criteria.
- **Title:** every run of whitespace becomes one space and the ends are trimmed. List markers stay. If nothing is left, it throws an error saying the title is empty.
- **Cleaning criteria:** whitespace is collapsed first. Then one leading marker (`-`, `*`, `1.`, `2)`, `[ ]`, `[x]`) is removed, but only when a space or the end of the text follows it, so something like "2.5 payouts" keeps its "2.". Criteria that end up empty are dropped.
- **Steps or plain:** a criterion is treated as steps only if its first word is Given, When or Then, in any case. It is then split before every whole word Given, When, Then, And or But, and each keyword is written capitalised. Any other criterion becomes one `Then` step with its first character lowercased. The exception is a first word that is two or more uppercase letters only (like "API") or contains a digit (like "V2"); then it is left as written.
- **Repeated titles:** each title has its own count, so repeats get " (2)", " (3)" and so on.
- **No criteria:** the file is the TODO feature naming the key.

Two edge cases the spec doesn't cover are left as is:
- A criterion that happens to read like a numbered repeat, such as "X (2)" alongside two plain "X" criteria, would give two scenarios with the same title.
- A "whole word" is anything between spaces, so a keyword with punctuation attached, like "Then,", isn't split on.
